fields.name: lifePath
fields.description: Your Life Path number (1-9, 11, 22, 33). Optional if year, month, day are provided.

fields.name: expression
fields.description: Your Expression number (1-9, 11, 22, 33). Optional if fullName is provided.

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full birth name to calculate the Expression number automatically. Use instead of passing expression directly. A name in any script is converted to Latin letters before it is counted, Cyrillic and Greek as the passport spelling and accents folded to the base letter, and the calculation lists the letters counted. For a script that does not write its vowels, send the Latin spelling the person uses.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Birth year to calculate Life Path automatically. Use with month and day instead of passing lifePath directly.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Birth month (1-12). Required with year and day for automatic Life Path calculation.

fields.name: day
fields.description: Birth day (1-31). Required with year and month for automatic Life Path calculation.
